exampleTamil: ஜன்னலுக்கு அருகில் இரண்டு பேருக்கு மேசை வேண்டும்.

name: What time does the train leave?
example: What time does the train leave for Chennai?

name: Is this seat taken?
example: Excuse me, is this seat taken?

name: How long is the journey?
example: How long is the journey to Madurai?

name: Where can I buy a ticket?
example: Where can I buy a ticket for the bus?

name: Does this bus stop at
example: Does this bus stop at the college?

name: I have a reservation under
example: I have a reservation under Kaleeswaran.

name: What time is checkout?
example: What time is checkout tomorrow?

name: Does the room have Wi-Fi?
example: Does the room have Wi-Fi access?

name: Can I get a wake-up call?
example: Can I get a wake-up call at 6 am?
exampleTamil: காலை 6 மணிக்கு எழுப்பும் அழைப்பு தர முடியுமா?

name: Is breakfast included?
example: Is breakfast included in the room price?

name: Tell me about yourself
example: Please tell me about yourself first.

name: What are your strengths?
example: What are your strengths and weaknesses?

name: Why should we hire you?
example: Why should we hire you for this role?
exampleTamil: இந்த பணிக்கு உங்களை ஏன் பணியமர்த்த வேண்டும்?

name: I'm a quick learner
example: I'm a quick learner and adapt easily.

name: Do you have any questions for us?
example: Do you have any questions for us before we finish?

name: Let's schedule a meeting
example: Let's schedule a meeting for next week.

name: I'll send you the report by
example: I'll send you the report by tomorrow.

name: Let's touch base next week
example: Let's touch base next week on this project.
exampleTamil: இந்த திட்டம் குறித்து அடுத்த வாரம் பேசுவோம்.

name: Please find attached
example: Please find attached the updated file.

name: Let's circle back on this
example: Let's circle back on this after lunch.
exampleTamil: மதிய உணவுக்குப் பிறகு இதை மீண்டும் பேசுவோம்.

name: Can you repeat that, please?
example: Sorry, can you repeat that, please?

name: I don't understand this part
example: Sir, I don't understand this part.

name: May I ask a question?
example: Excuse me, may I ask a question?

name: Let's go over this again
example: Let's go over this topic again.

name: Take notes carefully
example: Please take notes carefully during the lecture.
exampleTamil: விரிவுரையின் போது தயவுசெய்து கவனமாக குறிப்பு எடுங்கள்.

name: Call an ambulance!
example: Please call an ambulance immediately!

name: I need to see a doctor
example: I need to see a doctor urgently.

name: Where is the nearest hospital?
example: Excuse me, where is the nearest hospital?

name: I'm allergic to
example: I'm allergic to peanuts, please note.
exampleTamil: எனக்கு நிலக்கடலைக்கு ஒவ்வாமை உண்டு, தயவுசெய்து குறித்துக்கொள்ளுங்கள்.

name: It's an emergency
example: Please help, it's an emergency.

name: Take care
example: Take care, see you soon.

name: See you later
example: See you later, have a good day.

name: It was nice seeing you
example: It was nice seeing you again.

name: Have a safe trip
example: Have a safe trip back home.

name: Until next time
example: Until next time, take care of yourself.
